You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From e46b5a6470a5e2c8e1096f8f60887ac19949055b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2015 22:06:41 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: fix imx27 dtb build rule

The i.MX27 dtb build should be controlled by CONFIG_SOC_IMX27 rather
than CONFIG_SOC_IMX31.

Signed-off-by: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Fixes: cb612390e546 ("ARM: dts: Only build dtb if associated Arch and/or SoC is enabled")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>
---
 arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
index 86217db2937a..992736b5229b 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
@@ -223,7 +223,7 @@ dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX25) += \
 	imx25-eukrea-mbimxsd25-baseboard-dvi-vga.dtb \
 	imx25-karo-tx25.dtb \
 	imx25-pdk.dtb
-dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
+dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
 	imx27-apf27.dtb \
 	imx27-apf27dev.dtb \
 	imx27-eukrea-mbimxsd27-baseboard.dtb \
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrectly associating the i.MX27 device tree blob (dtb) build rule with the configuration option CONFIG_SOC_IMX31 instead of the correct CONFIG_SOC_IMX27. This misconfiguration meant that the build system would not include the i.MX27 dtbs when the corresponding SoC was enabled, leading to potential build failures or missing device support for the i.MX27 platform.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrectly associating the i.MX27 device tree blob (dtb) build rule with the configuration option CONFIG_SOC_IMX31 instead of the correct CONFIG_SOC_IMX27. This misconfiguration meant that the build system would not include the i.MX27 dtbs when the corresponding SoC was enabled, leading to potential build failures or missing device support for the i.MX27 platform.
